meta.title: Jagorar Fasaha ta Pain001: CLI, Python API da REST
meta.description: Cikakken jagora ga pain001 v0.0.56 — umarnan CLI da tutoci, Python API, endpoints na REST a /api/v1, littattafan ƙa'ida, daidaita shigarwa da plugins.
meta.deck: Kowace tuta, endpoint da hali na pain001 v0.0.56 — daga lambar da aka fitar, ba daga buri ba.

text.This reference documents the command-lin: Wannan jagorar tana bayyana mahaɗar layin umarni, Python API, ƙaramar hidimar REST, da kuma tsarin tantancewa na pain001 v0.0.56. Kowace tuta, endpoint da hali da aka lissafa a nan an ɗauko su ne daga lambar da aka fitar, ba daga buri ba.
text.Pain001 supports <strong>11 ISO 20022 me: Pain001 tana goyon bayan ma'anonin saƙo 11 na ISO 20022: daga pain.001.001.03 zuwa pain.001.001.12 (fara tura kuɗi na abokin ciniki, sigogi goma) da kuma pain.008.001.02 (fara cirar kuɗi kai tsaye na abokin ciniki).
text.1. Command-Line Interface<a class=\"head: 1. Mahaɗar Layin Umarni#
text.The <code>pain001</code> executable grou: Fayil ɗin aiwatarwa na pain001 yana tara ayyukansa cikin ƙananan umarni. Idan ka gudanar da shi da tutocin ƙirƙira kaɗai, yana kiran generate a fakaice, don haka tsarin sarrafa kai da kake da shi zai ci gaba da aiki.
text.Convert a data file into schema-validate: Juya fayil ɗin bayanai zuwa XML na ISO 20022 wanda aka tantance da schema (umarnin tsoho).
Tantance bayanan shigarwa ba tare da rubuta XML ba.
text.List all 11 supported message definition: Lissafa dukkan ma'anonin saƙo 11 da ake goyon baya.
text.Show the required and optional fields fo: Nuna filayen wajibi da na zaɓi ga wani nau'in saƙo.
text.Scaffold a starter CSV template for a me: Ƙirƙiri samfurin CSV na farawa ga wani nau'in saƙo.
text.Launch the FastAPI REST microservice (re: Ƙaddamar da ƙaramar hidimar REST ta FastAPI (tana buƙatar ƙarin api).
text.Launch the in-tree Model Context Protoco: Ƙaddamar da sabar Model Context Protocol da ke cikin lambar (kayan aiki 5; cikakkiyar sabar mai kayan aiki 17 tana zuwa a matsayin pain001-mcp).
text.Inspect and manage discovered loader, va: Duba da sarrafa plugins na loader, validator, scheme da writer da aka gano.
text.Input data: <code>.csv</code>, <code>.js: Bayanan shigarwa: .csv, .json, .jsonl, .db / .sqlite, .parquet, ko .gpg / .asc da aka ɓoye da PGP.
text.Directory that receives the generated XM: Babban fayil ɗin da ke karɓar XML ɗin da aka ƙirƙira.
text.Override the bundled Jinja2 template or: Sauya samfurin Jinja2 ko schema na XSD da aka haɗa a ciki.
text.Load defaults from a configuration profi: Ɗauko tsoffin ƙimomi daga bayanan sanyi (--profile, --show-config).
text.Validate input against the JSON Schema,: Tantance shigarwa bisa JSON Schema, XSD, da littafin ƙa'idar tsari ba tare da rubuta fitarwa ba.
text.Report each scheme rule that passed or f: Bayar da rahoton kowace ƙa'idar tsari da ta ci nasara ko ta faɗi, a sigar da mutum ko na'ura za ta iya karantawa.
text.Memory-bounded chunked processing for la: Sarrafawa a gutsuttsura tare da iyakancewar ƙwaƙwalwa don manyan tarin bayanai (tsoho: mu'amala 1,000 a kowace gutsure; kowace gutsure tana zama fayil ɗin XML na kanta tare da NbOfTxs da CtrlSum da aka sake ƙidayawa).
text.Emit machine-readable run metrics for ob: Fitar da ma'aunan gudanarwa da na'ura za ta iya karantawa don tsarin sa ido.
text.Exit codes are CI-friendly: <code>0</cod: Lambobin fita suna dacewa da CI: 0 nasara, 1 faɗuwar tantancewa, 2 kuskuren amfani.
text.2. Python API<a class=\"heading-anchor\": 2. Python API#
text.Every generated document passes three la: Kowace takardar da aka ƙirƙira tana wucewa ta yadudduka uku kafin a rubuta ta:
text.<strong>Input validation</strong> — each: Tantance shigarwa — ana duba kowane rikodi bisa JSON Schema na nau'in saƙon, tare da daidaita sunayen filaye da duba tsarin IBAN/BIC.
text.<strong>Scheme rulebook</strong> (option: Littafin ƙa'idar tsari (na zaɓi) — ƙa'idojin SEPA SCT, SEPA Instant, SEPA SDD Core, SEPA B2B, ko na tura kuɗi tsakanin ƙasashe.
text.<strong>XSD validation</strong> — the re: Tantancewar XSD — ana tantance XML ɗin da aka samar bisa schema na hukuma na ISO 20022 ta hanyar xmlschema kafin a rubuta ko baiti ɗaya a faifai.
text.Monetary amounts are handled as <code>de: Ana sarrafa kuɗaɗe a matsayin decimal.Decimal yayin ƙirƙirar XML da tantance tsari — ba a taɓa amfani da floats na IEEE 754 ba — kuma ana sake ƙidaya jimillolin sarrafawa na NbOfTxs / CtrlSum daga rikodin da aka tantance maimakon dogara ga shigarwa.
text.Beyond pain.001 generation, the core lib: Baya ga ƙirƙirar pain.001, ɗakin karatu na tushe yana kuma zuwa da mai karantawa da ƙirƙirar rahoton matsayi na pain.002 (don ka iya karanta amsar karɓa ko ƙi ta bankinka) da kuma mai karantawa da ƙirƙirar bayanin asusu na camt.053 don daidaita asusu a ƙarshen rana, tare da VersionMapper da ke tura rikodi tsakanin sigogin saƙo.
text.3. REST Microservice<a class=\"heading-a: 3. Ƙaramar Hidimar REST#
text.All endpoints are mounted under <code>/a: Ana ɗora dukkan endpoints a ƙarƙashin /api/v1 (tare da wani suna maras siga /api):
text.Validate records; returns field-level er: Tantance rikodi; yana mayar da kurakurai a matakin filaye.
text.Queue a large batch for background gener: Sanya babban tari a jerin gwano don ƙirƙira a baya.
Sauke XML ɗin da aka gama.
text.Interactive documentation is served at <: Ana bayar da takardun hulɗa a /api/docs (Swagger UI), /api/redoc, da /api/reference (Scalar), yayin da takardar OpenAPI take a /openapi.json.
text.4. Input Normalisation<a class=\"heading: 4. Daidaita Bayanan Shigarwa#
text.Pain001 coerces real-world exports into: Pain001 tana mayar da bayanan da aka fitar daga tsarin aiki na hakika zuwa rikodi masu inganci kafin tantancewa:
text.<strong>Field aliases</strong> — common: Sunayen madadin filaye — sunayen ginshiƙai da suka zama ruwan dare a ERP suna daidaituwa da filayen asali (misali amount → payment_amount).
text.<strong>IBAN / BIC normalisation</strong: Daidaita IBAN / BIC — ana cire fanko, a daidaita manya da ƙanana haruffa, sannan a duba (ISO 13616 mod-97 don IBAN, tsarin ISO 9362 don BIC).
text.<strong>Dates</strong> — ISO 8601 <code>: Kwanaki — ana karanta ranakun aiwatarwa a tsarin ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD.
text.<strong>Amounts</strong> — routed throug: Kuɗaɗe — suna wucewa ta decimal.Decimal; kuɗaɗen da ba su da tsari mai kyau suna faɗin tantancewa maimakon a zagaye su a shiru.
text.<strong>Character set</strong> — transli: Tarin haruffa — kayan taimako na canza rubutu suna mayar da abun ciki zuwa tarin haruffan Latin na ISO 20022 da SWIFT da SEPA suke karɓa.
text.5. Plugin Architecture<a class=\"heading: 5. Gine-ginen Plugin#
text.The suite is extensible through four ent: Ana iya faɗaɗa wannan tsarin ta ƙungiyoyin shiga huɗu: pain001.loaders, pain001.validators, pain001.schemes, da pain001.writers. pain001-loader-xlsx yana yin rijista ta wannan hanya kuma ana gano shi kai tsaye bayan shigarwa; pain001-loader-mt101 ɗakin karatu ne mai zaman kansa na karanta fayiloli da ake amfani da shi kai tsaye (haka kuma kayan aikin convert_mt101 na sabar MCP yana amfani da shi). Wani maɓallin kashewa — PAIN001_DISABLE_PLUGINS=1 — yana kashe gano plugins na waje gaba ɗaya a muhallai masu tsauraran ƙa'idoji.
text.6. Quality Gates<a class=\"heading-ancho: 6. Ƙofofin Inganci#
text.The core library is developed against st: Ana haɓaka ɗakin karatu na tushe bisa ƙofofi masu tsauri da ake iya tabbatarwa: rufin gwaji na kashi 100% na layuka da na rassa da ake tilastawa a CI (--cov-fail-under=100), tsauraran nau'ika na mypy, kashi 100% na docstring, da binciken tsaro (Bandit, pip-audit). Ana samar da SBOM na CycloneDX ga kowace fitarwa.
text.Continue with the <a href=\"/installatio: Ci gaba da Jagorar Shigarwa, sabar MCP don wakilan AI, ko ƙamus ɗin biyan kuɗi.

meta.title: Tambayoyin Pain001 ga Baitulmali, Ayyuka da Injiniya
meta.description: Dalilin da bankuna ke ƙin fayilolin biya, bambancin pain.001 da pain.008, wa'adin Nuwamba 2026, manyan tarin bayanai, tsaro da sake samar da bayanai.
meta.deck: Amsoshi kai tsaye ga masu baitulmali, ayyukan biyan kuɗi, injiniyoyi da masu bincike — kamar yadda mutane ke tambaya da gaske.

text.<a href=\"#for-engineers-and-architects\: Ga injiniyoyi da masu ƙirar tsari
text.<a href=\"#for-auditors-and-compliance\": Ga masu bincike da bin ƙa'ida
text.Straight answers for treasurers, payment: Amsoshi kai tsaye ga masu baitulmali, ayyukan biyan kuɗi, injiniyoyi da masu bincike. An tsara tambayoyin kamar yadda mutane ke yin su da gaske. Don ƙarin bayani na fasaha, duba Jagorar Fasaha.
text.For treasury and finance leaders<a class: Ga shugabannin baitulmali da kuɗi#
text.<code>pain.001</code> is the ISO 20022 m: pain.001 shi ne saƙon ISO 20022 da abokin ciniki ke aikawa bankinsa domin fara tura kuɗi — magajin XML ga tsare-tsare kamar SWIFT MT101 da fayilolin gida masu layi ɗaya. Bankinka yana tantance shi bisa schema da littafin ƙa'idar tsari kafin ya karɓe shi. Pain001 (manhajar) tana samar da waɗannan fayilolin daga bayanan da kake da su, tana kuma tabbatar da ingancinsu kafin ka gabatar da su.
text.Direction of the pull. <code>pain.001</c: Alkiblar kuɗin ce ta bambanta. pain.001 yana fara tura kuɗi — kana fitar da kuɗi. pain.008 yana fara cirar kuɗi kai tsaye — kana karɓar kuɗin da ake binka bisa izini. Pain001 tana samar da su duka: sigogi goma na pain.001 (daga .001.03 zuwa .001.12) da pain.008.001.02.
text.<strong>We still send MT101 files. How u: Har yanzu muna aika fayilolin MT101. Yaya gaggawar sauyawa take?
text.Urgent. SWIFT retired MT category 1, 2 a: Gaggawa ce. SWIFT ta janye saƙonnin MT na rukunin 1, 2 da 9 don umarnin biyan kuɗi tsakanin bankuna a ƙasashen waje a watan Nuwamba 2025; hanyoyin kamfanoni da suke har yanzu karɓar MT suna yin hakan bisa ra'ayin kowane banki kuma na ɗan lokaci ne. Loader ɗin MT101 yana juya hanyoyin MT101 da kake da su zuwa pain.001 da aka tantance ba tare da sake shigar da komai ba.
text.<strong>What does the November 2026 stru: Me wa'adin adireshi mai tsari na Nuwamba 2026 ke nufi a gare mu?
text.From the end of November 2026, fully uns: Daga ƙarshen Nuwamba 2026, ba za a ƙara karɓar adiresoshin gidan waya marasa tsari gaba ɗaya a biyan kuɗi tsakanin ƙasashe na CBPR+ ba; dole adireshi ya kasance mai tsari ko haɗaɗɗe — sassa daban-daban kamar gari () da ƙasa () maimakon layukan rubutu kyauta. Idan bayananku na asali suna riƙe da adiresoshi a matsayin rubutu guda, aikin yana cikin bayananku ne, ba a haɗin bankinku ba. Ku fara daga can. Takaitaccen bayanin 2026 ya yi bayanin lokutan dalla-dalla.
text.Nothing. The core is dual-licensed Apach: Ba kome. Tushen yana da lasisi biyu na Apache-2.0 / MIT; ƙarin fakitocin suna ƙarƙashin Apache-2.0. An ba da izinin amfani na kasuwanci, gyarawa da sake rarrabawa. A matsayin ma'auni na kwatanta, SDK na fassara na SWIFT kaɗai yana kan €10,000–30,000 a shekara.
text.For payment operations<a class=\"heading: Ga masu ayyukan biyan kuɗi#
text.<strong>Why do banks reject payment file: Me ya sa bankuna ke ƙin fayilolin biyan kuɗi?
text.Four recurring causes: schema violations: Dalilai huɗu ne ke maimaituwa: karya ƙa'idar schema (kuskuren sashe, kuskuren siga, kuskuren namespace), alamun ganewa marasa kyau (faɗuwar checksum na IBAN, BIC marasa tsari), jimillolin sarrafawa da suka ɓaci (NbOfTxs / CtrlSum da ba su dace da mu'amaloli ba), da haruffa a wajen tarin Latin na ISO 20022. Pain001 tana duba dukkan huɗun kafin fayil ya kasance: tantance JSON Schema ga kowane rikodi, duban IBAN da mod-97 da na BIC da ISO 9362, sake ƙidaya jimillolin sarrafawa, canza haruffa, da tantancewar XSD ta ƙarshe ga XML ɗin da aka samar.
text.<strong>Can we validate a file without g: Za mu iya tantance fayil ba tare da ƙirƙirar komai ba?
text.Yes — <code>pain001 --dry-run</code> (or: Eh — pain001 --dry-run (ko ƙaramin umarnin validate, ko POST /api/v1/validate). Lambar fita 0 na nufin fayil ɗin yana da inganci; 1 na nufin tantancewa ta faɗi tare da kurakurai a matakin filaye. Ka haɗa shi cikin CI ko cikin jerin duba kafin gabatarwa.
text.<strong>Which SEPA rulebooks are covered: Waɗanne littattafan ƙa'ida na SEPA ake tallafawa?
text.Five scheme rulebooks ship built-in: SEP: Littattafan ƙa'idar tsari guda biyar suna zuwa a ciki: SEPA Credit Transfer (sepa-sct), SEPA Instant (sepa-inst), SEPA Direct Debit Core (sepa-sdd), SEPA B2B (sepa-b2b), da tura kuɗi tsakanin ƙasashe (xborder-ct). Yi amfani da --scheme --explain don ganin kowace ƙa'ida da ta ci nasara ko ta faɗi.
text.Excel silently coerces IBAN-like strings: Excel yana juya rubutun da yake kama da IBAN zuwa lambobi a shiru. Loader ɗin Excel yana karanta .xlsx/.xlsm kai tsaye kuma yana tsayawa nan take idan ginshiƙan IBAN suna ɗauke da sel na lambobi — ana kama lalacewar a lokacin ɗorawa, ba a banki ba.
text.<code>--streaming</code> processes input: --streaming yana sarrafa shigarwa a gutsuttsura masu iyakancewar ƙwaƙwalwa (tsoho: mu'amala 1,000), kuma ana fitar da kowanne a matsayin fayil ɗin XML nasa tare da jimillolin sarrafawa da aka sake ƙidayawa daidai. REST API tana bayar da POST /api/v1/generate/async tare da duba matsayin aiki saboda dalili guda.
text.For engineers and architects<a class=\"h: Ga injiniyoyi da masu ƙirar tsari#
text.<strong>How do we integrate it — library: Yaya za mu haɗa shi — ɗakin karatu, CLI, ko API?
text.All three exist as first-class surfaces:: Dukkan ukun suna nan a matsayin manyan hanyoyi: Python API mai nau'ika bayyanannu, CLI mai lambobin fita da suka dace da CI, da ƙaramar hidimar FastAPI (pain001 serve) mai endpoints na aiki kai tsaye, na aikin async, na lafiya, da na ma'aunan Prometheus. Tsarin tantancewa ɗaya ne a ƙasa, don haka sakamako ba ya taɓa bambanta tsakanin hanyoyin.
text.<strong>Is the XML generation actually s: Shin ƙirƙirar XML tana da tsaro daga zagaye lambobi na float da gaske?
text.Amounts are <code>decimal.Decimal</code>: Kuɗaɗe suna kasancewa decimal.Decimal daga farko zuwa ƙarshe a ƙirƙira da tantance tsari — ana karanta su a matsayin lambobin goma cikakku, a haɗa su a matsayin lambobin goma cikakku, kuma a fitar da su ba tare da wakilcin float ba. Ana sake ƙidaya jimillolin sarrafawa daga rikodin da aka tantance, ba a taɓa dogara ga shigarwa ba.
text.All XML parsing routes through <code>def: Dukkan karanta XML yana wucewa ta defusedxml (yana toshe hare-haren XXE da faɗaɗa entity); babu lxml a cikin itacen dogaro. Shigarwa tana wucewa ta mai tantance hanyar fayil. Hoton Docker yana aiki ba a matsayin root ba. Ana samar da SBOM na CycloneDX ga fitarwar tushe, kuma ana iya kashe gano plugins na waje gaba ɗaya da PAIN001_DISABLE_PLUGINS=1.
text.100% line and branch coverage as a hard: Rufin gwaji na kashi 100% na layuka da na rassa a matsayin ƙofa mai tsauri a CI kan tushen (a tabbatacce: layuka 3,828, rassa 926 kan 100%), tsauraran mypy, kashi 100% na docstring, binciken tsaro na Bandit da pip-audit, da binciken CodeQL. Ƙarin fakitocin suna riƙe da wannan ka'idar ta kashi 100% ɗin.
text.<strong>Can we extend it for a proprieta: Za mu iya faɗaɗa shi don wani tsari na kanmu?
text.Yes — four plugin entry-point groups (<c: Eh — akwai ƙungiyoyin shiga huɗu na plugin (pain001.loaders, pain001.validators, pain001.schemes, pain001.writers). Loader ɗin Excel shi kansa plugin ne da ke amfani da yarjejeniyar jama'a, don haka yana aiki kuma a matsayin misalin aiwatarwa.
text.For auditors and compliance<a class=\"he: Ga masu bincike da bin ƙa'ida#
text.<strong>Can we reproduce a file that was: Za mu iya sake samar da fayil ɗin da aka ƙirƙira a kwata da ya wuce?
text.Yes. Pin the package version, replay the: Eh. Ka ƙayyade sigar fakitin, ka sake gudanar da shigarwa iri ɗaya, fitarwar kuwa ba za ta sauya ba. Tunda kayan aikin buɗaɗɗen tushe ne, hanyar binciken tana kaiwa har cikin lambar kanta — ba kawai takardar shaida ta mai sayarwa ba.
text.<strong>Does payment data leave our envi: Shin bayanan biyan kuɗi suna barin muhallinmu?
text.No. Every component — CLI, library, REST: A'a. Kowane sashe — CLI, ɗakin karatu, REST API, sabar MCP, LSP — yana aiki a cikin gida. Babu telemetry, babu kiran SaaS, babu hidimar tantancewa ta waje. Sabar MCP tana magana ta stdio kaɗai kuma an yiwa dukkan kayan aikinta 17 alamar karantawa kaɗai da rashin canja yanayi.
text.<a href=\"https://sebastienrousseau.com\: Sebastien Rousseau, shugaban injiniyanci na fintech mazaunin London, tare da masu ba da gudummawa daga al'umma. Ana gudanar da ci gaban a bayyane a GitHub, ana buga fitarwa a PyPI, kuma ana yiwa tarihin canje-canje siga a kowace fitarwa.

meta.deck: Python 3.10–3.12, pip ko Docker, da fayil ɗin biya da aka tantance cikin umarni uku.

text.Pain001 runs on <strong>Python 3.10, 3.1: Pain001 tana aiki kan Python 3.10, 3.11, da 3.12 (an gwada kowace siga a CI) a kan macOS, Linux da Windows. Ka shigar da abin da kake buƙata; kowace fasaha ta zaɓi ƙari ce daban, don haka shigarwar tushe tana kasancewa mai sauƙi.
text.01. PyPI<a class=\"heading-anchor\" href: 01. PyPI#
text.Core CLI & Python library: CLI na tushe & ɗakin karatu na Python
text.PGP-encrypted input files (<code>.gpg</c: Fayilolin shigarwa da aka ɓoye da PGP (.gpg / .asc)
text.Redis-backed async job queue for the API: Jerin gwanon ayyukan async na API bisa Redis
text.Built-in minimal MCP / LSP servers: Sabar MCP / LSP masu ƙarancin fasali da ke ciki
text.Companion packages install separately an: Ana shigar da ƙarin fakitocin daban kuma suna da sigogi masu zaman kansu:
text.Verify the install and explore the messa: Tabbatar da shigarwa sannan ka bincika jerin saƙonni:
text.02. Docker<a class=\"heading-anchor\" hr: 02. Docker#
text.Multi-architecture images (<code>linux/a: Ana buga hotunan gine-gine daban-daban (linux/amd64, linux/arm64) a GitHub Container Registry. Kwandon yana aiki a matsayin mai amfani na musamman wanda ba root ba.
text.03. Locked-down environments<a class=\"h: 03. Muhallai masu tsauraran ƙa'idoji#
text.Bank and treasury environments often pro: Muhallan bankuna da baitulmali sau da yawa suna hana ɗora plugins ta atomatik. Akwai matakan sarrafawa guda biyu domin wannan yanayin:
text.<code>PAIN001_DISABLE_PLUGINS=1</code> d: PAIN001_DISABLE_PLUGINS=1 yana kashe gano dukkan plugins na waje; loaders da aka haɗa a ciki kaɗai suke aiki.
text.Everything executes locally. No package: Komai yana aiki a cikin gida. Babu wani fakiti a cikin tsarin da ke aika bayanai zuwa waje, ko kiran SaaS API, ko fitar da bayanan biyan kuɗi daga na'urarka.
text.04. First file in three commands<a class: 04. Fayil na farko cikin umarni uku#
text.<code>--dry-run</code> validates against: --dry-run yana tantancewa bisa JSON Schema, XSD, da (tare da --scheme) littafin ƙa'idar SEPA ko na ƙasashen waje ba tare da rubuta fitarwa ba — lambar fita 0 na nufin bankinka ba zai ƙi fayil ɗin saboda dalilan schema ba. Cire --dry-run don rubuta XML ɗin.
text.Continue to the <a href=\"/documentation: Ci gaba zuwa Jagorar Fasaha don kowace tuta da endpoint, ko zuwa Tambayoyin Farawa don tambayoyin ayyuka.

meta.title: Ƙamus ɗin Biyan Kuɗi na ISO 20022 a Sauƙaƙe
meta.description: pain.001, pacs.008, camt.053, CBPR+, VoP, UETR, adiresoshi haɗaɗɗu, jimillolin sarrafawa — kalmomin biyan kuɗi ga masu baitulmali da ƙungiyoyin ayyuka.
meta.deck: Kalmomin biyan kuɗi a sauƙaƙe — ga waɗanda ke amincewa da fayiloli, ba kawai waɗanda ke ƙirƙira su ba.

text.Plain-English definitions of the terms t: Ma'anonin kalmomi a sauƙaƙe waɗanda ke bayyana a ko'ina cikin wannan shafin da kuma cikin takardun tashar bankinku. An rubuta su ga masu baitulmali da ƙungiyoyin ayyuka da farko, injiniyoyi na biyu.
text.Messages<a class=\"heading-anchor\" href: Saƙonni#
text.<strong>pain.001 — Customer Credit Trans: pain.001 — Customer Credit Transfer Initiation. Saƙon XML da abokin ciniki ke aikawa bankinsa domin ya ba da umarnin tura kuɗi ɗaya ko fiye. Iyalin "pain" na nufin fara biyan kuɗi; .001 ita ce lambar saƙon; sigar da ke bayanta (.001.09) tana ƙayyade schema.
text.<strong>pain.002 — Customer Payment Stat: pain.002 — Customer Payment Status Report. Amsar bankinka ga pain.001 ko pain.008 ɗinka: an karɓa, an karɓa a wani ɓangare, ko an ƙi, tare da lambobin dalili na ISO ga kowace mu'amala.
text.<strong>pain.008 — Customer Direct Debit: pain.008 — Customer Direct Debit Initiation. Tagwayen pain.001 a ɓangaren karɓar kuɗi: kana cire kuɗin da ake binka bisa izini maimakon fitar da kuɗi.
text.<strong>pacs.008 / pacs.009.</strong> Th: pacs.008 / pacs.009. Saƙonnin sasantawa tsakanin bankuna waɗanda umarninka ke zama bayan bankin ya karɓe shi. Kamfanoni ba sa rubuta waɗannan; bankuna ne ke musayarsu.
text.<strong>camt.052 / camt.053 / camt.054.<: camt.052 / camt.053 / camt.054. Rahoton asusu: rahoton tsakiyar rana, bayanin ƙarshen rana, da sanarwar cirewa ko shigar kuɗi bi da bi. camt.053 shi ne abin da ƙungiyoyin daidaita asusu ke amfani da shi kowace safiya.
text.<strong>MT101.</strong> The legacy SWIFT: MT101. Tsohon saƙon rubutu na SWIFT mai suna "Request for Transfer" wanda pain.001 ke maye gurbinsa. Za a dakatar da isar da MT101 tsakanin bankuna a ranar 14 ga Nuwamba 2026 domin pain.001.001.09; MT101 daga kamfani zuwa banki zai ci gaba ne kawai bisa ra'ayin kowane banki.
text.Schemes and rulebooks<a class=\"heading-: Tsare-tsare da littattafan ƙa'ida#
text.<strong>SEPA SCT / SCT Inst.</strong> Th: SEPA SCT / SCT Inst. Tsare-tsaren tura kuɗi na Yuro (na yau da kullum da na gaggawa) waɗanda littattafan ƙa'ida na European Payments Council ke sarrafawa. Tura kuɗi na gaggawa yana sasantuwa cikin daƙiƙu, a kowane lokaci na rana da dare.
text.<strong>SEPA SDD Core / B2B.</strong> Th: SEPA SDD Core / B2B. Tsare-tsaren cirar kuɗi kai tsaye na Yuro — Core ga masu amfani (tare da haƙƙin mayar da kuɗi), B2B ga kamfanoni (babu haƙƙin mayarwa, kuma an fi tsauri wajen duba izini).
text.<strong>CBPR+.</strong> Cross-Border Pay: CBPR+. Cross-Border Payments and Reporting Plus: ƙa'idojin amfani da ke tsara saƙonnin ISO 20022 don harkokin banki na wakilci na SWIFT. Idan mutane suna cewa "sauyawar SWIFT zuwa ISO 20022", CBPR+ suke nufi.
text.<strong>HVPS+.</strong> The equivalent p: HVPS+. Irin wannan tsari ne ga manyan tsarin biyan kuɗi masu ƙima (T2, CHAPS, Fedwire da makamantansu).
text.<strong>CGI-MP.</strong> Common Global I: CGI-MP. Common Global Implementation — Market Practice: ƙungiyar da ke daidaita yadda kamfanoni ke amfani da saƙonnin pain a bankuna daban-daban, domin tsari guda ɗaya ya isa ga abokan hulɗar banki da yawa.
text.<strong>Verification of Payee (VoP).</st: Verification of Payee (VoP). Binciken daidaiton suna da IBAN da EU ta wajabta ga dukkan tura kuɗi na SEPA tun 9 ga Oktoba 2025. PSP ne ke yin sa a lokacin aiwatarwa; tsaftataccen bayanin mai karɓa ne ke tabbatar da daidaituwa.
text.Identifiers and data<a class=\"heading-a: Alamun ganewa da bayanai#
text.<strong>IBAN.</strong> International Ban: IBAN. Lambar Asusun Banki ta Ƙasa da Ƙasa (ISO 13616), mai duba kanta ta hanyar checksum na mod-97 — shi ya sa ake gano musanyar lamba ɗaya kaɗai kafin gabatarwa.
text.<strong>BIC / BICFI.</strong> The ISO 93: BIC / BICFI. Lambar Ganewar Kasuwanci ta ISO 9362 ta wata cibiyar kuɗi. Sashen XML shi ne a pain.001.001.03 amma daga siga ta 9 — sauyin suna da ke haifar da ƙi na gaskiya yayin haɓaka siga.
text.<strong>LEI.</strong> Legal Entity Ident: LEI. Lambar Ganewar Ƙungiyar Shari'a (ISO 17442) — lambar kamfani ta duniya mai haruffa 20. Sama da miliyan 3 suna aiki, kuma masu tsara doka suna ƙara wajabta su a harkokin biyan kuɗi.
text.<strong>UETR.</strong> Unique End-to-end: UETR. Nuni na Musamman na Mu'amala Daga Farko Zuwa Ƙarshe — UUID ɗin da ke ba da damar bin diddigin biyan kuɗi a sarƙar bankunan wakilci (SWIFT gpi).
text.<strong>Structured / hybrid address.</st: Adireshi mai tsari / haɗaɗɗe. Adiresoshin gidan waya a matsayin sassa daban-daban na XML (titi, gari, lambar gidan waya, ƙasa) maimakon layukan rubutu kyauta. Daga 14 ga Nuwamba 2026, CBPR+ tana ƙin adiresoshi marasa tsari gaba ɗaya; haɗaɗɗe — gari da ƙasa masu tsari tare da layukan adireshi biyu na haruffa 70 — ya ci gaba da inganci.
text.<strong>NbOfTxs / CtrlSum.</strong> The: NbOfTxs / CtrlSum. Jimillolin sarrafawa na kan rukunin saƙo: yawan mu'amaloli da jimillar kuɗi. Bankuna suna sake ƙidaya su; idan naka bai dace ba, fayil ɗin zai koma. Pain001 tana samo su koyaushe daga rikodin da aka tantance.
text.<strong>Charge bearer.</strong> Who pays: Mai ɗaukar kuɗin hidima. Wanda ke biyan kuɗaɗen hidima: DEBT (mai aikawa), CRED (mai karɓa), SHAR (a raba), SLEV (bisa ƙa'idar tsari). Tsofaffin MT OUR/BEN/SHA suna dacewa da ukun farko.
text.<strong>Remittance information.</strong>: Bayanin dalilin biya. Filin "me ake biya" — rubutu kyauta (haruffa 140) ko nuni mai tsari. Abin da ƙungiyoyin daidaita asusu ke fatan kowa ya cika shi yadda ya kamata.
text.Tooling terms used on this site<a class=: Kalmomin kayan aiki na wannan shafin#
text.<strong>XSD validation.</strong> Checkin: Tantancewar XSD. Duba XML bisa ma'anar schema ta hukuma ta ISO 20022. Pain001 tana ɗaukarsa a matsayin ƙofa mai tsauri kafin a rubuta kowane fayil.
text.<strong>MCP — Model Context Protocol.</s: MCP — Model Context Protocol. Ma'auni buɗaɗɗe da mataimakan AI ke amfani da shi don kiran kayan aiki na waje. pain001-mcp tana bayar da kayan aikin biyan kuɗi 17 ga kowane abokin ciniki na MCP, a cikin gida ta stdio.
text.<strong>LSP — Language Server Protocol.<: LSP — Language Server Protocol. Ma'aunin haɗa editoci da ke bayan binciken kuskure a cikin IDE. pain001-lsp tana amfani da shi don tantance fayilolin biyan kuɗi yayin da kake rubutu.
text.<strong>SBOM.</strong> Software Bill of: SBOM. Jerin Kayan Software — jerin dukkan abubuwan dogaro a cikin fitarwa wanda na'ura za ta iya karantawa, ana samar da shi a tsarin CycloneDX ga fitarwar tushe na Pain001.
